mapper.insert: insert into attendance_record(person_id, department, name, attendance_date, position, type, repair_type, remark, actual_start_work_time, actual_end_work_time) values(#{attendanceRecord.personId}, #{attendanceRecord.department}, #{attendanceRecord.name}, #{attendanceRecord.attendanceDate}, #{attendanceRecord.position}, #{attendanceRecord.type}, #{attendanceRecord.repairType}, #{attendanceRecord.remark}, #{attendanceRecord.actualStartWorkTime}, #{attendanceRecord.actualEndWorkTime})
mapper.select: select department, name, attendance_date, position, type from attendance_record where name =#{name} and attendance_date = #{attendanceDate}
select id, date_str dateStr from sys_all_date where date_str >= #{startDate} and date_str <= #{endDate} and date_str < now() order by date_str

SELECT distinct uu.department, uu.position_name as `position`, uu.user_name as name, d.date_str attendanceDate, DATE_FORMAT(a.actual_start_work_time, '%H:%i') actualStartWorkTime, DATE_FORMAT(a.actual_end_work_time, '%H:%i') actualEndWorkTime, case when a.repair_type is not null then a.repair_type else case when a.`type` is null then 4 else a.`type` end end type, a.remark, (case when b.id is null then 1 else 0 end) as isWorkingDay, a.attendance_date, uu.person_id FROM sys_all_date d join (select us.name as user_name, o.org_name as department, dd.name as position_name, us.person_id from u_user us left join u_org_staff_rel r on us.user_id = r.staff_id left join u_org o on r.org_id = o.org_id left join t_dict dd on dd.status_cd = r.rel_cd and dd.table_name = 'u_org_staff_rel' and dd.table_columns = 'rel_cd' where us.status_cd = '0' and r.status_cd = '0' and o.org_id in ('1399','1400','1401','1402','1403','1404','1405','1406','1407','1408','1409','1410','1411','842026051862340001','842026092970420003','842026092981930004','842026092990810005','842026092993470002','842026092998960006')
and o.org_name LIKE concat('%',#{dto.department},'%')
AND dd.name LIKE concat('%',#{dto.position},'%')
AND us.name LIKE concat('%',#{dto.name},'%') ) uu left join (select min(actual_start_work_time) actual_start_work_time, max(actual_end_work_time) actual_end_work_time, person_id, name, department, position, attendance_date, type, repair_type, remark from attendance_record where 1=1
AND attendance_date >= #{dto.lessAttendanceDate}
AND attendance_date <= #{dto.moreAttendanceDate}
group by attendance_date, person_id) a on d.date_str = a.attendance_date and a.person_id = uu.person_id
and uu.department LIKE concat('%',#{dto.department},'%')
AND uu.position_name LIKE concat('%',#{dto.position},'%')
AND uu.user_name LIKE concat('%',#{dto.name},'%')
AND (a.actual_start_work_time IS NULL OR a.actual_end_work_time IS NULL OR a.actual_start_work_time > #{dto.fixedStartWorkTime} OR a.actual_end_work_time < #{dto.fixedEndWorkTime})
AND uu.user_name in
#{item}
left join attendance_non_work_day b on d.date_str BETWEEN b.start_date and b.end_date where d.date_str < now()
and (b.id is null or (b.id is not null and a.actual_start_work_time is not null))
and b.id is null
and b.id is not null and a.actual_start_work_time is not null
AND d.date_str >= #{dto.lessAttendanceDate}
AND d.date_str <= #{dto.moreAttendanceDate}
AND ((case when a.repair_type is not null then a.repair_type =#{dto.type} else a.`type` = #{dto.type} end ) or a.attendance_date is null)
AND (case when a.repair_type is not null then a.repair_type =#{dto.type} else a.`type` = #{dto.type} end)
ORDER BY d.date_str DESC, uu.person_id
limit #{dto.page}, #{dto.row}
